description: pkix-path/tests/pkits_4_6_4_7.rs:311-316 — basic_constraints_corrupt_der_returns_malformed_certificate uses std::fs::read at runtime to load test fixtures, while all other tests in the file use pkits_cert() which also uses fs::read via CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR. Both approaches work but the corrupt-bc fixtures are stored in tests/fixtures/ (a different path than the PKITS fixtures in tests/pkits/certs/). Consider using include_bytes! for test/fixtures/ DER files to make the test hermetic and prevent breakage if the working directory changes. Minor: the comment says 'See pkix-path/tests/fixtures/gen-corrupt-bc.py if present, or the test comment in git' but neither reference is reliably available.
title: pkix-path test basic_constraints_corrupt_der uses fs::read instead of include_bytes
